# lifesim-fdyo: Stubble/makeup overlays: random dots read as specks, need directional hair masks and AO-like shade
task · P4 · auto, lane:creator

## Description
W1-3 synthetic stubble layer (tools/make_layers.py) is 1024px isolated dots at uniform density; in Unity and Godot alike it reads as dirty specks. Identical in both engines (UMA overlay data), not an engine defect. A better look needs: 2048 masks, short directional strokes following the beard growth, density gradient (jaw/chin dense, cheeks fade), a soft darker base-shade layer under the dots (fake AO/shadow of hair), colour from the hair colour. Face does receive shadows when a light is present (lit shots in results/sheet-stubble*.png).

## Acceptance Criteria
Owner approves a stubble and beard layer look in both engines at the face close-up.
